transcript.text: My Dyson V11 (SV14) battery has gone fat - the case has split along the seam. Can I prise it open and swap the cells, or is a £25 Amazon one ok?
First, let’s look at what the battery is doing. On a full charge, does it run only a short time before stopping, or will it not charge at all?
It runs for only a couple of minutes then cuts out. It's charging on the wall dock now and feels warm-ish, with a slight sweet chemical smell from the pack.

⚠ Stop using this appliance
If you can smell gas, treat it as an emergency: don't turn any switches on or off and no naked flames. Turn the gas off at the meter if you safely can, open doors and windows, and leave if the smell is strong. Call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999.
I don't think it's gas, the smell is coming from the battery pack itself. It's still on the dock and a bit warm. So what should I do with it?
